text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Last time I came to Hokkaido, I was in 
seriously bad shape. 
My right shoulder was hurting at the 
Hanshin Daishoten, so I couldn't even 
run...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And at the Takarazuka Kinen after that... 
I couldn't reach them at all. Not even 
close. 
I was in such a terrible slump... I 
honestly felt like giving up. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah! Tosen Jordan! 
Show 'em the kind of strength that won you 
Hakodateeee!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—They were just so warm. 
They had high hopes for someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was thinking about running 
away, or thinking it was totally hopeless 
anyway... 
...They believed in me more than I 
believed in myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—So, that's why... 
I was able to believe in myself too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I owe them so, so much. That's why... 
since this is such a good chance, to 
everyone in Hokkaido—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—I've gotta tell them. 
Without running away. Straight from the 
heart...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!! 
Woooow...!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Even if the staging changes, what I have 
to do here doesn't. 
Reach out. Toward the light. —Never giving 
up, time and time again.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what do you think? Pretty cool, 
right? 
I look awesome, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—It's all thanks to everyone! 
That I was able to become who I am today!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Woooo! Tosen Jordan!! 
Thanks for coming back to see ussss!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Aha. Saying 'thanks' to me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's totally my line, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That concludes today's performance! 
We look forward to seeing you all again~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was the best! Thank you so much—! 
Come back again! We'll be waiting for 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I'd given up on ever seeing the Holy Hoof 
Festival in person, but... 
I'm so glad you came!!! Thank youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ......Aha. Ahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad we did this.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, on three! 
MAAARVELOOOUUUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Maaarvelooouuus♪ 
M-Marvelous...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Food, food! 
I'm starving, it's so marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, has everyone tried the hot pot yet? 
Isn't it seriously unreal? It's so bono, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ It's Ishikari nabe made with 
Hokkaido salmon~! 
There's plenty of it, so have as many 
seconds as you like~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Like, seriously. 
Wasn't that a massive success? For real.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah♪ The audience had such bono smiles... 
ehehe. 
It made me smile so much too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Indeed. Especially that sea of 
lights— 
I never could have imagined it. My heart 
was pounding so hard.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ It's definitely because we 
delivered real Marvelous! 
That's why they sent it right back to us! 
An extra-special Marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Indeed. It was the best—no, I 
believe we achieved results beyond even 
that. 
Once again, great work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Great work, everyone~. 
Now let's do our best with packing up, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Akebono~! 
The bus is leaving. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah... okay! 
I'm coming right now~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The tent is gone after just one day, huh. 
Feels kind of lonely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. 
It does feel lonely.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right? 
That's why we're gonna start all over 
again☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We've only done one regional show so far! 
That's nowhere 
neeeear enough! We've gotta deliver waaaay 
more Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not just across Japan, either! Across the 
whole world too! 
Because a circus travels all over! So—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, where should we head next?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~! Where should we go next? Further 
south? 
Kyushu has tons of bono things too, right? 
I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry Akebono! Hold on a second! 
There was something I had to say!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Next time, we'll definitely come to your 
town too! 
Aha☆ Bye-by—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—See ya later! 
MAAARVELOOOUUUUS☆★☆
